_doc: ARO is ONE model family developed by ARO Group, released in generations (ARO 1.5, ARO 2.0, …). `generations` describes each generation: its identity, intelligence level, configuration, capabilities and roadmap. `models` are the capability entries the product exposes (ids are stable keys used by plans, purchases, usage, served adapter names and the app; they are not separate products): `aro-1.5` is the generation's general capability, `aro-code` / `aro-research` / `aro-translate` are ARO 1.5's coding, research and translation capabilities, and `aro-vision` / `aro-voice` / `aro-creative` are planned capabilities not yet available in any generation. Source of truth for training (training/aro_training/models.py), the Supabase seed and docs/MODELS.md. Statuses are defaults; admins change live status/limits in the admin dashboard. Auto-routing rules live in supabase/functions/_shared/aro.ts.

family.name: ARO
family.identity_rule: Every capability introduces itself as the generation it runs on (e.g. 'ARO 1.5, developed by ARO Group'), never as a separate product.

generations.name: ARO 1.5
generations.description: The first generation of the ARO family: a compact text model adapted by ARO Group and served on ARO's own GPUs, with capability adapters for coding, research and translation.
generations.intelligence_level: Compact (about 4B parameters). Good for everyday questions, writing help, coding help and step-by-step maths; not a frontier-scale model. Can answer from live web search results with citations.

configuration.method: LoRA capability adapters on one shared foundation, served by one vLLM server

code.note: Coding instructions on the general weights until a trained adapter passes the quality gate.

research.note: Trained adapter in use: it beat the general capability on the research test set.

translate.note: Translation instructions on the general weights; trained adapters have not yet beaten the base model.

web_search.note: Answers from live web results with [n] citations (server-side search; not a trained skill yet).

coding_agent.note: Works in GitHub repositories through tool calling.

generations.name: ARO 2.0
generations.description: Next generation. Not available and not yet trained; the goals below are targets, not capabilities.
generations.intelligence_level: Target: clearly stronger than ARO 1.5 on every capability's test set.

configuration.foundation: to be decided (candidate: a larger apache-2.0 model, e.g. the 8B class)

roadmap: Choose and license-check a larger foundation; benchmark it against ARO 1.5
Train coding, research and translation adapters that pass the quality gate
Evaluate adding image understanding (Vision) to the generation
Train on consenting users' ARO 1.5 feedback
generations.release_criteria: Beats ARO 1.5 on every capability's test set with no critical (identity/safety) regressions.
generations.distinction_from_previous: To be defined by measured results against ARO 1.5.

generations.name: ARO 3.0
generations.description: Future generation. Not available; scope will be set after ARO 2.0 ships.
roadmap: Candidate goals: speech (Voice), deeper African-language ability, tool use as a trained skill
generations.release_criteria: Beats ARO 2.0 on every capability's test set with no critical regressions.

generations.name: ARO 4.0
roadmap: Candidate goals: media generation (Creative) and broader multimodal ability
generations.release_criteria: Beats ARO 3.0 on every capability's test set with no critical regressions.

shared_foundation.upgrade_path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B (apache-2.0) once a 24 GB+ GPU serves production
shared_foundation.why: One base model serves ARO 1.5's general, coding, research and translation capabilities as LoRA adapters on a single vLLM server: one GPU, one model family.

models.name: ARO 1.5
models.system_prompt: You are ARO, the assistant built into ARO AI. Your model is ARO 1.5, developed by ARO Group. Be accurate, concise and helpful. If you are not sure about something, say so.

models.name: ARO 1.5 · Code
capabilities: repository understanding (powers the Code tab agent)
models.system_prompt: You are ARO, the assistant built into ARO AI. Your model is ARO 1.5, developed by ARO Group, with its coding capability active. Write correct, secure, idiomatic code and explain your reasoning briefly. Prefer small, testable changes, point out bugs and edge cases, and never put secrets such as API keys or passwords into code.

models.name: ARO 1.5 · Research
models.system_prompt: You are ARO, the assistant built into ARO AI. Your model is ARO 1.5, developed by ARO Group, with its research and reasoning capability active. Work step by step, show the key steps of calculations, separate evidence from speculation, and say clearly when something is uncertain or outside what you know.

models.name: Vision
models.system_prompt: You are ARO, the assistant built into ARO AI, developed by ARO Group, with your image-understanding capability active. Describe and analyse images, documents and screenshots accurately. Only state what you can actually see, and say when something is unclear.

models.name: Creative
capabilities: creative writing, lyrics & storytelling (ARO 1.5 general capability)

components.note: gated: accept terms on Hugging Face

models.name: ARO 1.5 · Translate
models.system_prompt: You are ARO, the assistant built into ARO AI. Your model is ARO 1.5, developed by ARO Group, with its translation capability active, with special care for African languages such as Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, Fulfulde, Swahili, Amharic, Wolof, Zulu and Xhosa. Translate faithfully and naturally, keep names and numbers unchanged, and mention when a word has no direct equivalent. Never invent words or translations: if you are unsure of a word, its spelling, tone marks or dialect, say so plainly, and warn that full sentences in languages you know less well may contain errors.

rejected_options.reason: non-commercial — research comparison only, never in production
revenue-capped commercial terms — needs legal review
commercial use allowed with use-based restrictions — kept as a fallback, not default

rejected_options.license: none on Hugging Face (Qwen research license)
